title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
description: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.

title: Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold
description: For parents in parts of Ukraine, trying to lead a normal family life with just a few hours of power each day is taking its toll.

title: Government could force media industry to improve safeguards after Walliams allegations
description: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy could force participation in an industry watchdog to protect whistleblowers, the BBC understands.

title: Significant drop in levels of toxic 'forever' chemicals in England's rivers
description: The decline has been put down to severe restrictions placed on the substances' use.

title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
description: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.

title: Are max strength cold and flu pills worth the money?
description: Some cold and flu remedies cost 20 times as much as a basic pack of paracetamol or ibuprofen.

title: Israeli strike on hospital kills at least five Palestinians, Gaza civil defence agency says
description: The strike hit the surgery department of the hospital in Khan Younis, injuring at least 20 people and causing extensive damage, a spokesperson says.

title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
description: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.

title: Lego marketplace BrickLink offline after 'unusual activity' detected
description: Known as the eBay of Lego, it has been down for three days and is yet to disclose what caused the shutdown.
